'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]]
***[[Hamas]] says that it has agreed to resume [[ceasefire]] talks and release [[Israeli Americans|American Israeli]] hostage Edan Alexander following a proposal from U.S. Middle East envoy [[Steve Witkoff]]. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/5194717-hamas-israel-hostages-ceasefire-proposal-gaza/ (''The Hill'')]
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Islamic State insurgency in Iraq (2017–present)|Islamic State insurgency in Iraq]]
***[[Iraq]] announces that the deputy head of the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] in [[Iraq]] and [[Syria]], Abdallah Maki Mosleh al-Rifai, was killed in the [[Al Anbar Governorate]] during a joint operation between [[Iraqi security forces]] and the [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iraqi-pm-says-islamic-state-leader-iraq-syria-killed-2025-03-14/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/iraq-islamic-state-leader-killed-syria-eb56ab8a4d8c07d0233206fe1bb55a06 (AP)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Four people, including [[Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam]] district chief Maulana Abdullah Nadeem, are injured in a bombing at the Maulana Abdul Aziz Mosque mosque in [[South Waziristan District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://indianexpress.com/article/pakistan/senior-cleric-among-4-worshippers-injured-in-bomb-explosion-at-mosque-in-pakistan-9886693/ (''Indian Express'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024–2025 Cuba blackouts]]
**A failure at a [[power station|central power plant]] cuts [[electricity]] in [[Cuba]], leaving over ten million people without power. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/03/14/americas/cuba-power-blackout-darkness-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2025 Oklahoma wildfires]]
**Severe winds and dry conditions in the U.S. states of [[Oklahoma]] and [[Texas]] cause a series of [[wildfire]]s, forcing [[emergency evacuation|evacuations]] and leaving thousands [[power outage|without power]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/14/us/wildfires-texas-oklahoma.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Tornado outbreak of March 14, 2025]]
**Three people are indirectly killed by storms as a regional risk for an outbreak of severe weather is outlined by the [[Storm Prediction Center]] over much of the [[United States]]. A rare [[List of Storm Prediction Center high risk days|high risk convective outlook]] is issued for tomorrow over the [[Deep South]]. [https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/archive/2025/day2otlk_20250314_1730.html (Storm Prediction Center)]
*At least two people are killed and one other is injured in a [[landslide]] at a [[salt mining|salt mine]] in [[Karak District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://english.aaj.tv/news/330407074/two-died-one-injured-in-landslide-at-karaks-salt-mine (Aaj News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[South Africa–European Union relations]]
**[[European Commission]] [[President of the European Commission|President]] [[Ursula von der Leyen]] announces that the [[European Union]] will invest {{Euro}}4.7 billion (US$5 billion) in [[aid]] and [[UNDP South Africa|development projects]] in [[South Africa]] after the [[United States]] ended most of its [[USAID]] programs. [https://www.dw.com/en/eu-to-invest-5bn-in-south-africa-after-us-aid-withdrawal/a-71915894 (DW)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/european-union-announces-47-billion-euro-investment-package-south-africa-2025-03-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[South Africa–United States relations]]
**[[U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Marco Rubio]] declares [[South African Ambassador to the United States|South African Ambassador]] [[Ebrahim Rasool]] ''[[persona non grata]]'' for his criticism of [[Donald Trump 2024 presidential campaign|Donald Trump's 2024 presidential campaign]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/14/us-expels-south-african-ambassador-over-criticism-of-trump (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] publicly asks [[Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] to spare the lives of "thousands of [[Ukrainian Armed Forces|Ukrainian soldiers]]" said to be surrounded in [[Kursk Oblast]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/vladimir-putin-ukraine-surrender-after-donald-trump-calls/story?id=119801808 (ABC News)]
